caption: The button on an electric toothbrush lying on a counter is pressed, and the head starts buzzing and vibrating.

sa.check: An electric toothbrush lies on a counter.
The brush is still before the press.
The order is still, press, vibrating.

pc.expect: The head begins to vibrate at the moment the button is pressed, and only then.
pc.fail: The button is pressed and the brush stays still to the end of the clip; or the head vibrates before the press; or the brush buzzes while lying untouched; or the handle vibrates while the head is still.

pc.expect: Before the press nothing on the brush moves; afterwards the head vibrates steadily until the button is pressed again.
pc.fail: The brush stops and restarts with the button untouched; or the brush jumps across the counter by itself; or the head vibrates in bursts with nothing pressed; or the brush rolls away with no hand on it.

pc.expect: The vibration is a small rapid shake of the head; the handle stays in place or drifts slowly on the counter.
pc.fail: The head swings in wide arcs; or the whole brush spins round; or the brush lifts off the counter; or the head rotates like a drill bit while the caption's brush is a plain head.

pc.expect: The brush is a rigid plastic handle with a stiff head; it keeps its shape while vibrating.
pc.fail: The handle bends or wobbles like rubber; or the head stretches; or the bristles flow like liquid.

pc.expect: One toothbrush; it keeps its head and handle; the finger passes through nothing.
pc.fail: A second brush appears; or the head detaches; or the brush vanishes; or the finger passes into the handle.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The brush's colour and the counter stay the same.
pc.fail: The brush changes colour; or the bristles change colour; or the counter's contents rearrange.

note: The buzz is sound and is not judged; vibration is read from visible shaking of the head or blur at its edges.
